clips.title: The story
paras: During the festive season of Hallow's End, Innkeeper Norman of the Undercity offers a piece of candy to travelers helping an ailing child. To earn the Undercity Mint, adventurers must cast aside their dignity and flap about like a chicken.

The Undercity is rarely known for laughter or warmth, built as it is beneath the ruins of Lordaeron by the liberated Forsaken. Yet when Hallow's End arrives, even the grim denizens of the Trade Quarter join in seasonal revelry. Innkeeper Norman holds onto a stash of Undercity Mints, designated for those collecting treats on behalf of young Spoops, a sick orphan in need of holiday cheer.

Rather than surrendering the treat outright to seasoned adventurers, Norman demands a bit of humiliating spectacle. Believing that grown warriors and spellcasters ought to earn their confections, he refuses to part with the mint until the petitioner mimics a barnyard chicken right before his counter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we? I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Undercity Mint - you will need to... Cluck like a chicken! Yes, chickens love mints... Well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... But I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!
Well adventurer, are you up to the challenge or not?! Time to earn your treat!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Too funny! Well done, friend! Here's your treat.
